info.name: CareConnect — Patient APIs
info.description:
Public and patient APIs used by the CareConnect mobile app (Ionic) against Payload CMS.

**How to use**
1. Import this file in Postman (File → Import).
2. Set `baseUrl` — local CMS is `http://localhost:3000`; EC2 edge is `http://<elastic-ip>` with **no** `:3000`.
3. Run **Auth → Login (patient)** first. The test script stores `jwt`. Later requests send `Authorization: JWT {{jwt}}` (not Bearer).
4. Seeded demo patient: `ayesha.karim@careconnect.demo` / `Patient123!`.

**Not in this collection**
- Payload Admin UI CRUD (doctors, slots, knowledge, unresolved queries).
- Internal `/api/internal/*` (Go RAG only; nginx denies these from the public internet).
- Go RAG `:8080` — unpublished; `/healthz` must fail from a laptop.

Patients cannot create appointments or reviews through generic REST. Use `/book` and `/submit`. Clinic replies are **read-only** — only an admin `humanResponse` in Unresolved Queries answers the patient.

request.description: Payload built-in probe. A `200` means the CMS is up (used by Docker healthchecks). No JWT required. On EC2 call the public IP on port 80, not `:3000`.

Creates a `role: patient` user and returns a session `{ token, user }` (`201`). Used by the mobile Create account screen.

Body: `name`, `email`, `password` (all required).
Fails with `400` if the email is already taken. Stores `jwt` on success.

Patient login used by the mobile app. Returns `{ token, user }`.

Admin accounts get `403` here — they must use Payload Admin (`POST /api/users/login`), not this route.
`401` = bad credentials. Saves `jwt` for the rest of the collection.

Demo seed: `ayesha.karim@careconnect.demo` / `Patient123!`.
Confirms the stored JWT is still valid. Mobile calls this on app start. Response is `{ user }` or `{ user: null }` when unauthenticated.

Payload REST list of active doctors. Public (`anyone`). Mobile Home / Doctors screens use this, then mark `availableToday` from today's open slots.
Saves the first doctor's `id` into `doctorId`.
Single doctor for the details screen. Public. Run **List active doctors** first so `doctorId` is set.
Open slots for the local calendar day. Public. Mobile uses this only to compute each doctor's `availableToday` badge. `todayStart` / `todayEnd` are set automatically before every request.

item.name: List future slots for a doctor

request.description:
Booking calendar for one doctor: future available **and** booked slots. Booked times are shown in the UI but cannot be selected. The book endpoint still claims the slot atomically.
Saves the first `available` slot into `slotId`.
Published reviews for a doctor. Public read. Generic REST **create** is closed — patients write through Submit review.

Patient write path for reviews. Requires JWT.

Rules: one review per doctor; the patient must have a **past booked** appointment with that doctor (slot start already passed). `appointmentId` is optional — the server picks an eligible past visit if omitted.

Returns `{ id, doctorId, rating, comment, ratingAverage, reviewCount }`.
`alreadyReviewed` / not-eligible errors if those rules fail.
The caller's appointments only — access control uses the JWT, never a user id in the query. `depth=2` so mobile can show doctor and slot times. Saves the first id into `appointmentId`.
Appointment details. `403` unless the row belongs to the JWT user.

body.raw:
{
  "slotId": "{{slotId}}",
  "contactName": "Ayesha Karim",
  "contactPhone": "+8801711000000",
  "contactEmail": "ayesha.karim@careconnect.demo",
  "patientNote": "First visit — please allow extra time."
}

request.description:
Only patient write path for bookings. Generic REST create is closed.

The **patient is taken from the JWT**, not the body. Slot is claimed with an atomic `available → booked` CAS plus `uniq_active_slot`.

Required: `slotId`, `contactName`, `contactPhone`, `contactEmail`. Optional `patientNote` (max 500).
Run **List future slots** first so `slotId` is an available slot. Concurrent book of the same slot returns slot-unavailable.
Add or replace the patient's special request after booking. Generic REST update is admin-only. Body: `{ patientNote }` (max 500, empty string clears it).

Cancels the caller's appointment and releases the slot to `available`. No body.

Blocked if already cancelled or inside the 1-hour cancel window (`cancelTooLate`). Returns `{ id, status: "cancelled", slotStatus: "available" }`.
Quick-start chips on the Chat screen. Payload REST; only `active: true` rows, sorted by `order`.

item.name: Get or create active chat session

request.description:
Returns the patient's current Redis chat session, or creates one. Mobile opens Chat with this. History lives in Redis (24h TTL, max 20 messages), not Mongo.
Saves `sessionId`.
Start a fresh session (`201`). No body. Prefer **Get or create active** unless you explicitly want a new id.
Load one owned session (id must belong to the JWT user). Staff-injected messages are stripped from the public payload.

header.description: Optional trace id; Payload logs it.

request.description:
The only public RAG chat route. Payload calls unpublished Go RAG; the mobile app never talks to Ollama or the vector store.

Body: `sessionId` (UUID from a session call), `question` (1–1000 chars).
Raise Postman timeout to **210000 ms** — first answers on a small instance can take a minute.
Rate limit: 20 asks / 60s per user (`429`).

`grounded: false` means the sufficiency gates declined. Those questions are stored as unresolved queries for an admin `humanResponse`. Outages return `502`/`503` and do **not** create an unresolved row.
Clears Redis history for this session and returns the empty public session. Used by the Chat “new conversation” control.

Unresolved questions belonging to the JWT user, including admin `humanResponse` when present. Mobile **Replies** tab.

`waitingOn: staff` = still waiting; a non-empty `humanResponse` is treated as answered. Patients **cannot** POST replies — only admins type `humanResponse` in Unresolved Queries and save.
Saves the first id into `clinicReplyId`.
One owned clinic reply for the conversation screen. `404` if the id is missing or belongs to another patient. Read-only — there is no messages POST.

item.name: 7. Admin portal (not used by the app)

request.description:
Payload's built-in admin login. The **mobile app does not call this**. Patient accounts should use `/api/auth/patient/login` instead.
Use this only to inspect admin-only REST (unresolved queries, RAG settings) from Postman. After login, copy `token` into `jwt` manually if needed.
